claim: On May 10, 2024 Amazon MQ added a version support calendar. When an engine version reaches end of support, Amazon MQ updates all brokers on that version to the next supported minor version automatically, and gives at least a 90 day notice before the end of support.
question: What happens when an Amazon MQ engine version reaches end of support, and how much notice is given?
note: d029. Current-truth pages: activemq-version-management and rabbitmq-version-support (upgrade within 45 days after the end-of-support date, during maintenance windows).
